metadata.description: Plugins shipped with communicate — the fabric that lets agents reach a person's own devices. Currently one family: driving an Android phone, generally and per app.

plugins.name: phone
plugins.description: Drive an Android phone as an agent: read device state through content providers and dumpsys, act through intents and deep links, and use the screen as the residual route with occlusion-safe targeting. Skill phone is the method; doordash is a worked per-app mastery (deep-link straight to a dish's option sheet, set modifiers, build a cart, and stop there); phone-ask answers questions about the device. Skill pay mints a one-time virtual card on the device for a checkout the person approves per purchase — the agent fills fields by name and never handles the number. Skill screens is the multi-agent story: an unrooted phone can hold several trusted displays at once, so an agent whose work needs the screen takes one of its own instead of waiting for the lease — one app to one display, and the person's screen left alone. ubereats maps the same ground on Uber Eats, where there is no working store deep link and half the screens cannot be dumped. Includes a screenshot route (phone shot / tap --shot) for apps whose screens never go idle and cannot be dumped at all.
